## 13 October 2026

**Author:** Zhao

There are three levels of UUID — **collection**, **dataset**, and **layer** (the individual variables within one dataset). We need to be very specific about which level of UUID we mean when we run a search.

Total views per collection is only a surrogate for popularity: while it shows the general trend, there are some mismatches. For example, the eBird collection has 40,988 views, which is surprisingly high.
